every_withheld_definite_record_is_restat.why: the weaker half of the same rule: a unit that keeps some record while losing its definite one has still been silenced about the thing that was withheld

no_unit_vanished_from_the_diff.why: a withheld statement must be replaced by a stated one, never by nothing

no_unsettled_identity_is_also_definitely.why: an unresolved unit that reaches changed_logical_ids is both at once

pin_off_still_reproduces_the_pre_repair_.population_note: a property of the whole frozen universe. A --limit run truncates the population and can fail this honestly, which is why the canary re-runs the differential unlimited rather than reading a stored one
pin_off_still_reproduces_the_pre_repair_.why: the reference arm must still be production. If no unit_removed becomes unresolved anywhere, pin OFF is no longer the behaviour the repair is being compared against

the_document_level_channel_is_untouched.why: the repair is about units; a structural record must not move

reported_not_gated.relationship_to_closure_v1: descriptive only. IDENTITY_CHANGE_MIGRATION_CLOSURE_V1 graded FAIL on INVARIANT_6 and that verdict is permanent. Nothing here rescores it, repairs it, or uses it as a denominator
reported_not_gated.why: no threshold in this repository is calibrated; a rate bar invented here would be an uncalibrated number presented as a measured one. The identical share is reported with its denominator and graded by nothing

subject_code.observed_module_default_is_not_an_input: both arms pass quarantine_unsettled_identity explicitly; this value is recorded as an observation of the tree, not as an input
